key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:c/endcli:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in a state block into a caller-supplied destination buffer when that pointer is non-null, then makes an indirect call through a pointer held in a register.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0000
name: open_libraries_then_wait
description: Program entry point that clears a large work area, opens the DOS and exec libraries, duplicates the current directory lock and allocates memory, then loops waiting on a message port for incoming messages.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0180
name: close_handles_and_free_state
description: Cleanup routine that closes DOS file handles and locks, closes the exec library and frees a memory block, then replies to a message with Forbid and ReplyMsg to release the sender.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:01F8
name: set_channel_mask_for_index
description: Looks up a per-channel record from a table using the low bits of its argument; for channels zero to three it clears two fields of that record and stores a one-bit channel mask into a global variable. It does not write the hardware control register directly.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:021E
name: repeat_call_then_clear_flag
description: Calls a subroutine sixteen times in a counting loop and then clears a one-byte global flag. The callee is not identified in this code.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0234
name: arm_voice_for_channel_bit
description: Activates a voice record for the channel bit given in its argument. When the voice is idle it stores the bit into a shared mask, resets the voice position fields and, when a sample is attached, points the voice at the sample table and initialises its playback counters before calling a subroutine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:02B2
name: store_voice_sample_position
description: Stores a computed position and length into the voice record and its output block, then if the voice is active resets its effect counters and calls a subroutine that updates playback.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:02F0
name: store_voice_output_and_reset
description: Writes period and length values into the output block of a voice and, when the voice is active, resets its effect counters and calls a subroutine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:02FA
name: update_voice_output_and_reset
description: Copies period and length values into the output block of a voice, then resets the voice effect counters and calls a subroutine when the voice is active.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0322
name: select_voice_sample_entry
description: Stores the voice's current position, then either reads a value from the sample table for the chosen index or marks the voice as using a pointer-based sample; it resets the effect counters and calls a subroutine when the voice is active.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:033E
name: start_voice_from_table_entry
description: Marks a voice as active, points it at the shared sample table, reads the start value for the selected table index, resets the effect counters and calls a subroutine to begin playback.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:038A
name: advance_voice_command_tick
description: Runs one tick of a per-voice command stream: when the tick counter expires it reads the next command byte and applies its effect to volume, slide and period, then writes the resulting period and volume into the voice output block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:03D2
name: process_voice_command_stream
description: Processes the command bytes of one voice's stream on a tick, applying volume, slide and period effects and writing the resulting period and volume to the voice output block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:03E4
name: read_voice_commands_to_note
description: Reads consecutive command bytes from a voice's stream, applying each effect, until a non-command note byte is found, then stores that byte and updates the voice output fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:044C
name: tick_voice_effects_and_output
description: Continues a voice's per-tick update by advancing its effect counters, applying any pending slide or vibrato-style offsets and writing the period and volume to the voice output block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:049C
name: dispatch_voice_stream_command
description: Reads command bytes from a voice's stream and dispatches each one to an effect, such as volume, slide or sample-table change, until a note byte is reached and the note's pointer is stored in the output block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:04BA
name: apply_voice_stream_commands_loop
description: Loops over a voice's command bytes applying each effect to the voice fields, returning to the stream reader after every command until the loop reaches a note or a terminating command.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0562
name: step_voice_sample_table_index
description: Advances a voice's index into its sample table, adds the table offset to the voice base value, applies a vibrato-style offset when set, and writes the resulting period to the output block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:05F2
name: enter_infinite_loop_halt
description: Does nothing and spins forever in an empty loop, so calling it halts execution; it performs no other work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:060C
name: copy_voice_pointer_if_flagged
description: Tests bit zero of its input and, when that bit is set and the voice's stored value is non-zero, copies a pointer and a 16-bit value from the voice record into the destination it names. It returns the input shifted right by one bit.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0628
name: update_channel_mask_and_copy
description: When a shared flag is non-zero it calls four subroutines, stores a returned channel mask into a global variable, and performs the same conditional pointer copy into the voice record, returning the shifted flag bits.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0890
name: advance_song_row_for_channels
description: Runs the per-row playback step of the module: when the row counter wraps it loads the next pattern row for each channel, decodes its note, instrument and effect bytes into the channel records, and calls subroutines for every channel.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:08BE
name: decode_pattern_row_channels
description: Decodes one pattern row for the channels, storing note, instrument and effect fields into each channel record, then runs the first effect command of each channel and calls a subroutine for every channel.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0998
name: run_channel_special_commands
description: Handles the special per-channel commands: a volume-set command stores a value into the channel, a stop command clears the playback flag, and a sample-table jump command applies an offset; afterwards it continues the channel's tick loop.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:09A6
name: step_channel_effect_tick
description: Advances one channel's tick by handling the stop, sample-table jump and special effect codes, then updates the channel's effect state and calls a subroutine when the channel is still active.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:09C4
name: advance_channel_tick_effects
description: Runs the per-tick effect loop for one channel, handling the sample-table jump and special effect codes and updating the channel's effect counters before writing its output fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:09F0
name: process_channel_tick_commands
description: Processes the pending tick commands of a channel, updating its command index, sample-table position and output fields, and handles the special stop and jump codes.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0A02
name: advance_channel_note_tick
description: Steps a channel's note timing by one tick, reading the next command from the channel's pattern stream when its counter expires and writing the resulting output fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0A0C
name: apply_effect_code_to_channel
description: Dispatches a channel effect code to its handler: volume-set, speed, panning, sample offset, order jump and portamento-style slide effects each update their own channel record fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0A1A
name: apply_effect_code_fallthrough
description: Applies the effect code of a channel, covering the speed, panning, order-jump and slide cases, and then falls through to continue the channel's tick loop.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0A4C
name: apply_speed_panning_jump_effect
description: Applies the speed, panning, order-jump and slide effect codes to a channel record and then continues the tick loop, advancing the channel's stream position.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0A60
name: apply_portamento_and_jump_effect
description: Applies the panning, order-jump and slide effect codes to a channel record, storing the slide target and jump position, then continues the channel tick loop.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0A78
name: apply_slide_and_jump_effect
description: Applies the order-jump and slide effect codes to a channel record and then continues the channel tick loop, updating the stream position.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0A98
name: apply_portamento_effect
description: Applies the slide effect code to a channel record, updating its slide offset, and then continues the channel tick loop.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0AA8
name: advance_channel_sequence_step
description: Advances a channel's sequence step by one tick, applying the sample-table lookup and the pending effect codes, and writes the updated volume and period into the channel output block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0B98
name: walk_channel_effect_records
description: Walks the per-channel command records, decrements their timing counters and calls the effect handler stored for each active channel, returning once all channels have been processed.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0C00
name: apply_channel_volume_ramp
description: Ramps a channel's volume down by its stored step and clears the step when it reaches zero; when the channel is inactive it sets the channel's bit in the shared enable mask, then calls a handler chosen from a table.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0E14
name: advance_all_channel_streams
description: Steps through the four channel streams, reading each channel's next command or note, updating its timing and state and calling the per-channel handler from a table until the tick counter ends.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0E2C
name: lookup_or_divide_table_entry
description: Looks up a 16-bit value from a table when the index is below eleven, otherwise divides a fixed global constant by the index, then stores the low and high bytes of the result into two global bytes.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0E30
name: lookup_or_divide_table_entry
description: Looks up a 16-bit value from a table when the index is below eleven, otherwise divides a fixed global constant by the index, then stores the low and high bytes of the result into two global bytes.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0E70
name: compute_sample_address_offset
description: Works out a sample address and bit shift for a note: divides the note value by twelve for the octave, splits the period by seven or by thirty-one, and returns the resulting offset address, or the base table address when a field is zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0E96
name: compute_note_offset_address
description: Splits a note value into an octave and remainder, using a divisor of seven or thirty-one depending on a mode byte, and returns the resulting address offset and shift amount.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0EB6
name: offset_by_thirty_one_divisor
description: Divides its input by thirty-one to obtain a sample address offset and remainder, and returns the address adjusted by a table entry together with the shift amount.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0F10
name: scale_volume_table_and_copy
description: Scales a 16-entry source table by a volume byte taken from the voice structure into global 16-bit fields, then either clears a 62-byte region or copies a block from a secondary structure when one is attached.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0F7C
name: branch_on_check_result
description: Calls a check routine and, depending on whether its result is zero, calls one of two follow-up routines and returns zero or all-ones.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0F96
name: call_if_flag_set
description: Calls one routine only when a global flag is non-zero, then always calls a second routine before returning.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:0FA4
name: update_joystick_port_state
description: Clears bit zero of a port control byte through a stored pointer, sets or clears bit one from a flag in the structure, records the status values in globals, and then calls a routine that reads the port.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1010
name: clear_port_bit_then_call
description: When a global flag is set, clears bit zero of a byte through a stored pointer and calls the handler stored in a global, returning its result; otherwise returns zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:102A
name: open_audio_and_cia_resources
description: Initialises the sound system: allocates a signal, finds the current task, opens the audio device and the CIA resource, and assigns the port and control register addresses used by playback. It returns a status code, with error codes on each failure path.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1126
name: close_audio_and_free_signal
description: Stops the sound system: closes the audio device when it is open, frees the allocated signal and releases the CIA resource, then returns a status value.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1308
name: free_linked_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list of allocated entries, calling a release routine on each one, then clears the list head and count fields and returns zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1388
name: free_linked_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list of allocated entries, calling a release routine on each one, then clears the list head and count fields and returns zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1390
name: split_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command line into words, treating double-quoted text as one argument, translating star escape codes such as newline, and stores each argument pointer in a table while counting the arguments.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:13A6
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Empty routine that returns to its caller without doing any work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:13A8
name: open_resource_and_check_flags
description: Looks up a resource and returns failure when none is found; when a flag bit in the resource is set it calls a subroutine with a fixed argument, then runs a further subroutine and returns failure if a stored error field is non-zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1404
name: format_printf_style_string
description: Parses a printf-style conversion specification, reading flags, width, precision and length modifiers, fetches the matching argument from the stack and converts it to text with subroutines for integers, octal and hexadecimal values.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:17D6
name: emit_format_text
description: Copies the literal characters of a format string through an output callback and expands each conversion specifier by calling the formatter; a doubled percent sign is emitted as a single percent sign.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1824
name: initialise_stream_buffer
description: Prepares a stream record: when it has no buffer or its flag bit is set it allocates a new buffer, otherwise it reuses the existing one; on allocation failure it records an out-of-memory error and returns failure, and it clears the position fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:183A
name: allocate_stream_buffer_or_fail
description: Allocates a buffer for a stream record and, on failure, records an out-of-memory error and returns failure; on success it sets the buffer pointers and clears the position and flag fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1858
name: reset_stream_record_fields
description: Resets a stream record by restoring its default buffer size, clearing its flag bits and clearing its position counters.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1880
name: write_buffered_character
description: Writes one character into a stream buffer, expanding a line feed into a carriage return and line feed in text mode, and calls a flush subroutine when the buffer is full.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:189C
name: write_buffered_character
description: Writes one character into a stream buffer, expanding a line feed into a carriage return and line feed in text mode, and calls a flush subroutine when the buffer is full.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:18DC
name: write_padded_character
description: Writes a character into a stream buffer while counting down a remaining-width field; when the count is exhausted it calls the flush subroutine instead of writing.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:18F4
name: write_padded_character_reset
description: Reloads the remaining-width counter from a stored value and writes one character into the stream buffer, or calls the flush subroutine once the counter runs out.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1914
name: forward_to_stream_subroutine
description: Calls a stream subroutine and returns its result unchanged to the caller.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:192A
name: write_text_with_newline_translation
description: Writes a text string into a stream buffer, expanding each line feed into a carriage return and line feed, and records the number of characters written.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:193E
name: write_field_with_status_flags
description: Emits one formatted field into the stream after recording its width, sets an error or short-write flag from the subroutine result, and resets the position fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1966
name: write_field_and_set_flags
description: Emits one formatted value and sets an error or short-write flag according to the subroutine result, then resets the stream position fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1982
name: write_padded_text_field
description: Writes a text field into a stream buffer with optional width padding and repeated fill characters, and handles line feeds by writing a carriage return first.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:19D4
name: finish_formatted_field
description: Completes a formatted field by computing how many characters were written, emitting any trailing padding, setting error or short-write flags from the result, and resetting the stream position fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1A50
name: finish_text_field_output
description: Completes a text field by setting a short-write flag when the output length differs, resetting the stream position fields, and writing one pending character when the width counter remains above zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1A60
name: finish_field_with_value_check
description: Compares a value against the expected field value, sets a mismatch flag when they differ, resets the stream position fields and writes one pending character when width remains.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1A7E
name: write_pending_character_if_room
description: Resets the stream position to the start of its buffer and writes one pending character when it differs from the expected value and space remains.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1A8E
name: reset_position_and_write_pending
description: Resets the stream position to the start of its buffer and writes one pending character when it differs from the expected value.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1ABA
name: forward_stream_action
description: Passes control to a stream action routine without changing any state of its own.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1AD6
name: stub_no_operation
description: Empty routine that returns immediately and performs no work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1AE0
name: stub_no_operation
description: Empty routine that returns immediately and performs no work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1AF0
name: service_active_entries
description: Walks a table of entries from last to first, calling a handler for each entry whose flag byte is set and whose status bit is clear, then calls a final subroutine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1B48
name: load_time_zone_offset
description: Copies a time zone name from a source table into a time record, then converts the stored hour offset to seconds by multiplying by 3600 and sets a flag when a further field is non-zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1BF8
name: stub_no_operation
description: Empty routine that returns immediately and performs no work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1C0C
name: compute_timestamp_total
description: Combines a stored base offset with a computed count and a value returned by a subroutine into one total, stores it through the optional output pointer and returns it.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1CEC
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each lowercase letter of a null-terminated string to uppercase in place, using a character-class table to decide which characters to change.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1D2C
name: append_path_separators
description: Builds a file name by adding a colon after a device name, a slash or colon separator when none is present, and a dot before an extension when requested, returning the resulting end pointer.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1DC8
name: copy_string_until_terminator
description: Copies a null-terminated string from source to destination, including the terminator, and returns the position after the last character written.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1DE4
name: skip_class_characters
description: Advances past consecutive characters whose class bit is set in the character-class table and returns the first character that does not match.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1E0A
name: convert_integer_to_decimal_string
description: Converts an unsigned integer to a decimal string by repeated division by ten, reverses the digits into the output buffer, terminates it and returns the length.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1E36
name: convert_integer_to_octal_string
description: Converts an unsigned integer to an octal string by repeatedly taking three-bit groups, reverses the digits into the output buffer, terminates it and returns the length.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1E72
name: convert_integer_to_hex_string
description: Converts an unsigned integer to a hexadecimal string by extracting four-bit groups and mapping each to a digit character, reverses the output, terminates it and returns its length.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1E98
name: parse_signed_decimal_string
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and decimal digits from a string, stores the signed 16-bit value at the destination and returns the number of characters consumed.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1EE0
name: append_byte_to_buffer
description: Appends one byte to a growing output buffer and increments the buffer's length counter.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1EF8
name: format_string_into_buffer
description: Resets a counter, points the output at the caller's buffer, runs the formatter into it, terminates the result and returns the number of characters written.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:1F34
name: return_block_to_free_list
description: Returns a memory block to a sorted free list after rounding its size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight, merges it with adjacent free blocks and returns failure when it overlaps an existing entry.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:202C
name: run_action_if_check_passes
description: Calls a check routine and, when it succeeds, calls a follow-up action; returns failure if the check fails or a stored error flag is set.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2046
name: return_status_from_error_flag
description: Calls a routine and returns its result, replacing the result with failure when a stored error flag is set.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:205E
name: stub_no_operation
description: Empty routine that returns immediately and performs no work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2068
name: copy_memory_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a block of bytes of a given length, copying backwards when the destination overlaps the source so that no byte is overwritten before it is read.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:20B8
name: allocate_length_prefixed_buffer
description: Frees any buffer held in a global slot, then allocates a new buffer with a two-byte length header and returns a pointer just past the header, or null when the size is zero or allocation fails.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2108
name: run_action_with_fixed_argument
description: Calls a check routine and, when it succeeds, calls a follow-up routine with a fixed argument value; returns failure when the check fails or a stored error flag is set.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2150
name: allocate_linked_list_node
description: Allocates a memory block sized to the request plus a twelve-byte list header, links it at the end of a list of allocated entries and returns a pointer past the header, or null when allocation fails.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:21BC
name: run_two_actions_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, without any other logic.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:21F0
name: read_date_stamp_record
description: Reads the current date and time from the operating system into a fixed record, converting the year to an offset from 1900, computing the day of the week modulo seven, and returns the address of that record.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:22AC
name: convert_days_to_year_count
description: Reduces a day count from a base date by subtracting whole years, using 366 days for leap years and 365 otherwise, stores the remaining day count and returns the number of years counted.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:22FC
name: split_day_to_month
description: Splits a day-of-year value into a month index and a day within that month using a table of month lengths, with February adjusted for leap years, and stores the remaining day.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2360
name: allocate_from_free_list
description: Allocates a block of at least the requested size from a free list, rounding up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight, splitting a larger free block when enough remains, and returns null when no block fits.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2438
name: store_date_fields
description: Converts the operating system date stamp into a date record by turning the day count into year, month and day fields, and copies the time-of-day values into the record in the same layout.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2554
name: release_and_store_buffer_pointer
description: Calls a release subroutine for a buffer when its pointer is non-null and stores the buffer address, minus its two-byte header, into a global variable.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2578
name: flush_pending_entries
description: Walks a list of entries and calls a handler for each entry that is marked as pending and has differing size fields, then calls a final subroutine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:25CC
name: write_output_or_record_error
description: Clears the last error, writes through the DOS output function and, when the write fails, records the operating system error code and a general I/O failure code, returning the write result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:261C
name: seek_file_or_record_error
description: Clears the last error, seeks the file to the requested position and, when the seek fails, records the operating system error code and a seek failure code; one mode value triggers a follow-up seek.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2690
name: read_input_or_record_error
description: Clears the last error, reads from the DOS input function and, when the read fails, records the operating system error code and a general I/O failure code, returning the read result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:26D8
name: cleanup_message_port
description: Frees the memory attached to a message port, marks its signal as unused, removes the port from the system and resets its state fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2718
name: close_file_handle
description: Runs a subroutine when a stored handle is set and then closes the current file through the DOS close function, returning zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:273C
name: multiply_fixed_point_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values by combining the high and low 16-bit halves of each operand, returning the 32-bit product in the same format.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:275C
name: divide_signed_32_bit_values
description: Divides one signed 32-bit value by another using a normalised method and corrects the sign of the result; it falls back to a plain division when the divisor fits in 16 bits.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:278E
name: normalize_fixed_point_divide
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 32-bit divisor after normalising both operands, returning the quotient in the high 32 bits and the remainder in the low 32 bits.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2820
name: allocate_message_block
description: Allocates a memory block for an operating system message, sets its message type and stores the given argument pointer in it, returning the block or zero when the argument is zero or allocation fails.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:285C
name: initialize_message_port
description: Allocates a signal and a message port structure, sets its type, priority and name fields, and either registers the port with the system or initialises an empty message list; it returns zero when setup fails.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:28E8
name: lookup_table_entry_or_error
description: Returns the address of a table entry when the index is in range and the entry is in use; otherwise it records an invalid-argument error and returns zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2928
name: check_signal_and_run_callback
description: Reads pending signal bits and, when the relevant signal is set and a callback is registered, calls the callback and clears the stored callback pointer.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2970
name: allocate_zeroed_array
description: Multiplies an element count by an element size, allocates that many bytes and clears every byte to zero, returning the block or null when allocation fails.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:2992
name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Fills a block of bytes with a given value, counting the length down from its argument until every byte is written.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:0:29A0
name: call_subroutine_if_pointer_set
description: Returns zero when the pointer argument is null; otherwise it calls two subroutines and returns the stored result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:21:0000
name: split_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command line into words, treating double-quoted text as one argument, translating star escape codes such as newline, and stores each argument pointer in a table while counting the arguments.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:21:010C
name: setup_display_window_from_args
description: Checks the first argument against a fixed keyword, copies the remaining arguments into fixed-size name slots and initialises a display record covering a 320 by 200 area.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:21:0112
name: close_active_entries
description: Walks a table of entries from last to first, calling a handler for each entry that is flagged active and not locked, then calls a final subroutine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:0000
name: parse_arguments_and_open_display
description: Parses the command arguments into fixed name slots, sets up a 320 by 200 display record and calls thirteen subroutines to open the resources it needs.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:047A
name: read_keypress_with_mapping
description: Reads key events from the input queue, maps two raw key codes to internal key values and repeats until a recognised key arrives, then returns the mapped code.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:04D6
name: read_key_with_repeat_handling
description: Repeatedly reads key events, maps raw key codes to internal values and updates a display state byte, returning once a key is accepted.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:050A
name: read_mapped_key_once
description: Reads one raw key code, maps two specific raw values to internal codes, checks the key flag table and updates a state byte before returning the mapped key code.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:051E
name: wait_for_mapped_key
description: Loops until an accepted key arrives, toggling a state byte as it goes, and returns the code of the accepted key.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:052C
name: read_key_until_confirmed
description: Reads key events from a fixed starting code and keeps reading until an accepted key arrives, toggling a state byte as it goes, then returns the accepted code.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:053A
name: read_key_until_accepted
description: Reads key events starting from code zero and repeats until an accepted key arrives, toggling a state byte, then returns the accepted code.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:0568
name: restore_key_state_and_return
description: Swaps a saved state byte with the current one around a subroutine call, then returns the code stored in the call record.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:0596
name: edit_input_line
description: Reads characters into a line buffer, handling backspace to delete, return to finish and escape to cancel, echoing edits with a cursor state toggle and copying the finished line into the destination.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:05E8
name: read_input_line_into_buffer
description: Reads a line of text key by key, applying backspace, return and escape handling, and copies the completed text into the destination buffer.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:060E
name: accept_input_character
description: Handles one key of a line edit: backspace removes the last character, return finishes the line, and printable characters from the accepted set are stored in the buffer while space remains.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:069A
name: read_filtered_input_line
description: Accepts printable characters from an allowed set into a buffer up to a maximum length, recording a default value for each one, and returns when return or escape is pressed.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:0706
name: finish_input_and_return_status
description: Runs three finishing subroutines after input ends and returns the status code stored by the input routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:0728
name: match_key_to_string_index
description: Waits for a key, searches a string for the matching character and returns its index; otherwise it scans the string for the first character a subroutine accepts and returns that index.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:1:074C
